description.value: The Bread Company is a fifth-generation family bakery café whose baking heritage stretches back to 1851 in the Netherlands, now running three locations across Kelowna. The Bernard Avenue flagship sits in downtown Kelowna and serves a full breakfast and lunch menu built around house-baked artisan breads, pastries, specialty espresso drinks, and seasonal offerings like sorbets and gelato. Touring cyclists will find a substantial, made-from-scratch food stop with catering available for groups.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and is the primary evidence source. The site confirms the Bernard Ave location at 363 Bernard Ave with phone 250.762.3336, and explicitly mentions 'Vegan Artisan Breads' and order pickup/delivery options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill was found anywhere on the site, so those fields are null. One minor concern: the website's page-title banner reads '365 Bernard Ave' while both the OSM record and the location detail block on the same page read '363 Bernard Ave'.
